title: Signage Foundry
description: Design retro display type — an LED dot-matrix marquee, an airport split-flap board, and a VFD tube ticker — then export it as PNG or WebM.
concept: A three-mode retro signage studio built on one shared glyph engine: any typed character is sampled from a real system font into an intensity grid, then rendered as glowing LED dots, a flipping split-flap tile, or amber VFD segment bars. Tune color, density and scroll speed, save named presets, share a state-encoded link, or export a PNG snapshot and a looping WebM recording of the live animation.
features: 3 renderer modes sharing one glyph-sampling engine: LED dot-matrix marquee, split-flap departure board, VFD tube ticker
6 color themes, 3 density levels, adjustable scroll/flip speed, auto-cycling demo messages
Named presets saved to localStorage with load/delete
PNG snapshot export and looping WebM recording via MediaRecorder + canvas.captureStream

interaction.mouse: Type a message, drag sliders, click swatches and mode buttons
interaction.click: Switch modes, save/load presets, export PNG or WebM, copy share link
interaction.touch: Full touch support — mode chips, sliders and buttons are thumb-sized
interaction.keyboard: Type directly into the message field
